_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Not a credential, and not connected to any Firebase project.
The google-services plugin refuses to configure a variant whose package
name it cannot find, and the demo flavour's package is
lk.ac.ucsc.scs3311.smarthome.demo. That flavour never contacts Firebase:
AppContainer returns the in-memory backend when BuildConfig.USE_FAKE_BACKEND
is set, before any Firebase class is touched.
This file exists only so the plugin has something to match on, which is why
it is committed rather than ignored. The plugin searches src/<flavour>/
before the module root, so the demo variant reads this and the live variant
Consequence: `assembleDemoDebug` works on a fresh checkout with no Firebase
